top_signals.title: Hong Kong's Iconic Diners Go Global
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong has exported everything from cinema to finance. Now, its iconic cha chaan teng diners are going global too. Mary Hui explains how these humble cafes have become a symbol of culture, migration and identity. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
